Cell Content.status: Re-synced live 2026-09-16, on the 'Cell content' page of the GSL Components Library, after Gabriel added an icon-alignment axis and a zero padding. Variant props: Alignment (Horizontal/Vertical), 'Placeholder left alignement' (Middle/Top — note the misspelling, preserved), Padding (16/8/0), Clickable (ON/OFF), State (Default/Hover/Pressed/Disabled). Booleans: Description, Placeholder Left, Title, Body, Icon Right, Tag, Badge. Instance swap: '↳ Icon Right'. Three combination limits are enforced by the variant set itself, not by prose: 'Placeholder left alignement=Top' exists only with Alignment=Horizontal; Padding=0 exists only with Clickable=OFF, and covers all three non-clickable combinations; Clickable=OFF only ever pairs with State=Default, at every padding. 20 variants before this change, 33 after. RECLASSIFIED TO PATTERN 2 — this reverses the previous entry, which read 'Reclassified (was Pattern 2) — live isExposedInstance trace found no nested exposed instances'. A live walk on 2026-09-16 found '.placeholder left' exposed on all 33 variants, giving a designer the Type=Image/Icon switch on the leading slot. Gabriel confirmed the same day that the earlier Pattern 1 entry was simply wrong — the slot was not newly exposed. That entry carried no nodeId and no auditedDate, which is the tell for a classification never verified against the current file. Icon Right is still a BOOLEAN plus an INSTANCE_SWAP, never an exposed sub-component — that half of the old note held.
